summary: Orange Barrel Media is one active U.S. outdoor-media platform held through DigitalBridge Partners III, with 2025 as the supported entry year but the exact close date, stake, seller and investment vehicle not publicly disclosed. InfraBridge is not supported as a direct owner. IKE Smart City is a separate sister operating company rather than an OBM alias, and no direct OBM exit or pending sale was found through the as-of date.
